newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins little changed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins little changed in thin trade.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds were little changed in thin range-trading on Wednesday, ith no lead to follow from U.S. Treasuries and emerging markets, dealer said.
"The day is the same as the previous two or three," one dealer said. "Deals are few and prices are moving in certain ranges which are not giving any ideas about a trend."
Dealers said the 2008 maturity was the most-traded on the sleepy market.
"As usual, there is a clear link between moves of MinFins and those of U.S. Treasuries," an ICFI Moscow Partners Bank dealer said. "People are waiting for U.S data, which is mainly due next week."
He said market activity was likely to remain thin over the next three weeks ahead of Russia's May Day and Victory Day holidays followed by MinFin annual coupon repayments due May 14.
